g.title: Data operator: Triggers and watches runs, follows a record from its source file and row to the OSDU id and version it landed as, releases, redelivers or removes records, reads assertion reports and asks the assistant.

Workbench GUI: SQLFlow's workbench with the module's pages registered through the GUI module contract: pipelines and runs, lineage, the ledger and its records, the explorer of what OSDU holds, assertions, dimensions, inventories, templates, caches and the chat assistant. A static single-page app served by nginx; it calls the control plane's API.

Assistant gateway: Runs each chat or Explain question under a token delegated from the person for that run alone (its timeout plus 60 seconds, no admin or node scope), sends the model the MCP server's instructions and the conversation with the MCP server as its tool, streams the answer and keeps the conversation.

AI model provider: The chat model behind the GUI assistant and Explain: a Foundry deployment (gpt-5.1 in the shipped environments), or OpenAI or Anthropic by setting, plus an optional transcription deployment for voice. Off on a fresh deployment; no flow, mapping, render or delivery ever calls a model.

MCP server: osdu-delivery-mcp, a Model Context Protocol server: SQLFlow's server composed with the delivery module. Every assistant reads its instructions; it answers from metadata, and from data only for a ! question through a read-only query over what an approved AI context opens. It holds no credential: it forwards each caller's token.

AI context guard: Holds the AI contexts an administrator approved and the saved answers. prepare_query and run_query: one read-only SELECT over the columns the approved contexts open, checked on prepare and on run, redeemed by a single-use plan token that lives 15 minutes, run on a node as a compute task.

Compute node: SqlFlow.Delivery.Worker.Host: SQLFlow's worker with the module installed. It takes its work outbound from the control plane, so it can sit next to the data, and reads and writes the ledger in the osdu schema through the catalog's connection.
g.text: Pulls runs; executes the file, ing

g.title: Ingestion database: OsduData: the pre tables a file flow lands its files into, the keyed ingestion tables an ing flow upserts (stamping UpdatedDate_DW) and a delivery flow reads incrementally, and the tables dimension flows build. Snapshot isolation must be on.

Catalog database: OsduDelivery: SQLFlow's catalog (pipelines, runs, schedules, lineage, users, conversations) and, beside it, the osdu schema with its own migrations: the ledger, the audit trail, cache versions, the index of the repository's templates, partitions and the central configuration.
